title: nixpkgs-multiverse: fast mode
excerpt: “The fastest evaluation is the one that never happens.” – Sun Tzu, The Art of Evaluation
content_html:
“The fastest evaluation is the one that never happens.”

– Sun Tzu, The Art of Evaluation

nixpkgs-multiverse gives you every version of every package that ever shipped in Nixpkgs from a single flake input.

Note It continues to blow my mind that this is even possible. It feels like it suddenly unlocks a new dimension of Nixpkgs, and I am still trying to understand what it means. I think this capability is a fundamental change to the way we think about Nixpkgs, and it is not just a new feature. It is a new way of thinking about the entire ecosystem.

There was always a penalty at the center of it. Asking for a specific version of python3, such as 3.8.9, meant fetching the whole ~378 MB Nixpkgs tree from 2021 and evaluating it to determine the outPath.

What if we could skip that evaluation? What if we could just ask for the path directly, and have Nix fetch it from the cache if it is there?

This is a common idiom if you have ever used nix-store.

# check if the store has the path already
$ nix path-info --store https://cache.nixos.org/ \
      /nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9
/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9

# fetch it if it does
$ nix-store --realise /nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9
/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9

That requires knowing the store path upfront.

nixpkgs-multiverse now has a fast attribute that does exactly that: it gives you the store path for every indexed version of every package. This lets you skip the download and evaluation of Nixpkgs and get the store path straight from the cache.

$ nix build 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.versions.python3."3.8.9".out' \
      --print-out-paths
/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9

$ nix shell 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.versions.python3."3.8.9".out'
$ python3 --version
Python 3.8.9

No Nixpkgs is fetched. Nothing is evaluated. No experimental features and no --impure needed for this to work.

The complete Nix API, except for releases, works with this fast path.

# a specific version, zero-eval
mv.fast.version "python3" "3.8.9"
# newest indexed version, as of the pin
mv.fast.latest.python3
# what was current when the pin was cut
mv.fast.tip.hello
# a whole revision, as fakes
mv.fast.at "2022-03-15"
# exact revision keys work too
mv.fast."967d40bec14b".python3

If you want to learn more read the docs about the feature.

§The trick: mkFakeDerivation

Every nixos-unstable channel bump published a listing of every path Hydra built for it: store-paths.xz, or a MANIFEST for back in the pre-2017 era. These files are still available, and they are the source of the multiverse index.

The listing is a map from derivation name to store path. The multiverse index is a map from (attribute, version) to the revision that shipped it. By joining the two, every historical version gets a concrete address:

Knowing the path is not enough, especially in the Nix language. We need to convince Nix that a string that looks like a store path actually is a store path. builtins.storePath exists but it is an impure function and requires --impure to work.

How do we get around this?

We attach “context” to the String. Context is the invisible baggage a String carries in Nix. When you interpolate a derivation into a String, the result remembers where it came from, and that is what makes nix build realise the dependency instead of writing a dangling path into a script.

builtins.appendContext lets you attach it by hand.

storePath = p: builtins.appendContext p { ${p} = { path = true; }; };

The path = true identifies that “this String names a store path that must exist,” which is exactly what builtins.storePath produces for a path already in your store, except this works for a path that is not in your store yet and is not in this evaluation’s input closure either. Loopole! 👿

We then wrap that in an attrset that resembles like a derivation and the Nix CLI is satisfied:

{
  type = "derivation";
  name = "python3-3.8.9";
  pname = "python3";
  version = "3.8.9";
  system = "x86_64-linux";
  outputs = [ "out" ];
  out = storePath "/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9";
}

This is tomberek’s mkFakeDerivation trick from fastpkgs, and it is an amazing trick to circumvent needing --impure.

Everything about this remains pure evaluation, and the resulting graph is gauranteed to be bit-for-bit identical to what Nixpkgs would have produced if it had been evaluated. The only difference is that we skip the evaluation of Nixpkgs itself, and instead use the store path directly.

The eval path derives the address, the fast path remembers it.

§Footguns

A “fake” (mkFakeDerivation) derivation has no drvPath, because there is no .drv behind it. Nothing can build it and it can only be substituted. The nix CLI often wants a drvPath though when you hand it a derivation attrset, so we must make sure to append the output (i.e. .out):

$ nix build 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.latest.hello.out'
$ nix build 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.latest.ffmpeg.lib'

override and nix develop need a real derivation. Every fake derivation carries a lazy .eval that is the real, revision-exact derivation:

(mv.fast.version "python3" "3.8.9").eval.override { ... }

In the spirit of trying to keep my index small, meta is empty, so there is not additional information about the package. You can still get the meta from the real derivation by using .eval as well.

This scheme rests on cache.nixos.org still serving thirteen-year-old paths, which thankfully it does and with the same signing key.

To demonstrate that the cache is offering nearly every path that Nixpkgs ever built, I ran a census of every indexed version of every package and asked the cache if it was still alive.

As of August 14 2026, all 271,187 of them are alive. All of them, down to every NAR payload file. That is 14.8 TB of unpacked software from 2013 onward, one fast command away.11The NixOS infrastructure has never garbage collected the binary cache. It is an S3 bucket that only grows, and the bill is paid by the NixOS Foundation and its sponsors. 

There’s some other data on nixmultiverse.com about the census, dependency graphs and additional features. Check it out!

All of this is also available via the mvs command line tool as well for offline use.

# how big is it, unpacked, downloaded, and in full closure
$ mvs size python3@3.8.9
python3 3.8.9 · /nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9
  nar (unpacked)  50.1 MiB
  download        10.6 MiB
  closure         93.8 MiB · 16 paths
  cache           live

# who links against it
$ mvs rdeps pcre2
pcre2 10.47 · referenced by 255 indexed packages

# what is this path in my store, actually
$ mvs identify /nix/store/8qi947kixhz1nw83dkwxm6d0wndprqkj-hello-2.12.2
  package  hello 2.12.2

# run takes the fast path by default
$ mvs run hello@2.12.2
Hello, world!

I guess now there is a caveat: there is now a trick in the multiverse. It remains mostly an index, some JSON, and a fetchTree behind a memo table. The clever trick is tomberek’s, and it is three important lines.

content_html_zh:
“最快的评估是永远不会发生的。” ——《孙子》，《评估的艺术》

nixpkgs-multiverse 通过单个 flake 输入为您提供 Nixpkgs 中曾经发货的每个软件包的每个版本。

注意：这甚至是可能的，这一点仍然让我大吃一惊。 感觉就像它突然解锁了 Nixpkgs 的新维度，而我仍在尝试理解它的含义。 我认为这种功能是我们对 Nixpkgs 的看法的根本改变，而且它不仅仅是一个新功能。 这是一种思考整个生态系统的新方式。

比赛的中心总是有一个罚球。 请求 python3 的特定版本（例如 3.8.9）意味着从 2021 年获取整个约 378 MB Nixpkgs 树并对其进行评估以确定 outPath。

如果我们可以跳过该评估怎么办？ 如果我们可以直接询问路径，然后让 Nix 从缓存中获取它（如果存在）会怎么样？

如果您曾经使用过 nix-store，这是一个常见的习惯用法。

# check if the store has the path already
$ nix path-info --store https://cache.nixos.org/ \
      /nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9
/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9

# fetch it if it does
$ nix-store --realise /nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9
/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9

这需要预先了解存储路径。

nixpkgs-multiverse 现在有一个快速属性可以做到这一点：它为您提供每个包的每个索引版本的存储路径。 这使您可以跳过 Nixpkgs 的下载和评估，并直接从缓存获取存储路径。

$ nix build 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.versions.python3."3.8.9".out' \
      --print-out-paths
/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9

$ nix shell 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.versions.python3."3.8.9".out'
$ python3 --version
Python 3.8.9

未获取 Nixpkgs。 没有任何评价。 无需实验性功能，也无需 --impure 即可实现此功能。

完整的 Nix API（除了版本之外）都可以使用此快速路径。

# a specific version, zero-eval
mv.fast.version "python3" "3.8.9"
# newest indexed version, as of the pin
mv.fast.latest.python3
# what was current when the pin was cut
mv.fast.tip.hello
# a whole revision, as fakes
mv.fast.at "2022-03-15"
# exact revision keys work too
mv.fast."967d40bec14b".python3

如果您想了解更多信息，请阅读有关该功能的文档。

§技巧：mkFakeDerivation

每个 nixos-unstable 通道碰撞都会发布 Hydra 为其构建的每条路径的列表：store-paths.xz，或 2017 年前时代的 MANIFEST。 这些文件仍然可用，并且它们是多元宇宙索引的来源。

该列表是从派生名称到存储路径的映射。 多元宇宙索引是从（属性，版本）到发布它的修订版的映射。 通过将两者结合起来，每个历史版本都会获得一个具体的地址：

仅仅知道路径是不够的，尤其是在 Nix 语言中。 我们需要让 Nix 相信，看起来像存储路径的字符串实际上是存储路径。 builtins.storePath 存在，但它是一个不纯的函数，需要 --impure 才能工作。

我们如何解决这个问题？

我们将“上下文”附加到字符串上。 上下文是 Nix 中字符串携带的隐形行李。 当您将派生插入字符串时，结果会记住它来自哪里，这就是使 nix build 实现依赖关系而不是将悬空路径写入脚本的原因。

builtins.appendContext 允许您手动附加它。

storePath = p: builtins.appendContext p { ${p} = { path = true; }; };

path = true 标识“这个字符串命名了一个必须存在的存储路径”，这正是builtins.storePath 为存储中已存在的路径生成的内容，除了这适用于尚未在存储中且也不在此评估的输入闭包中的路径。 卢波尔！ 👿

然后我们将其包装在类似于派生的 attrset 中，并且 Nix CLI 得到满足：

{
  type = "derivation";
  name = "python3-3.8.9";
  pname = "python3";
  version = "3.8.9";
  system = "x86_64-linux";
  outputs = [ "out" ];
  out = storePath "/nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9";
}

这是 tomberek 的 mkFakeDerivation 技巧，来自 fastpkgs，这是一个规避 --impure 需求的惊人技巧。

关于此的一切仍然是纯粹的评估，并且所得到的图表保证与 Nixpkgs 在经过评估后生成的图表逐位相同。 唯一的区别是我们跳过了 Nixpkgs 本身的评估，而是直接使用存储路径。

eval 路径导出地址，fast 路径记住它。

§Footguns

“假”(mkFakeDerivation) 派生没有 drvPath，因为它后面没有 .drv。 没有任何东西可以建造它，它只能被替代。 nix CLI 通常需要一个 drvPath，但当您向它提供派生属性集时，因此我们必须确保附加输出（即 .out）：

$ nix build 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.latest.hello.out'
$ nix build 'github:fzakaria/nixpkgs-multiverse#fast.latest.ffmpeg.lib'

override 和 nix 开发需要真正的推导。 每个假派生都带有一个惰性 .eval ，它是真正的、修订精确的派生：

(mv.fast.version "python3" "3.8.9").eval.override { ... }

本着尽量保持索引较小的精神，元是空的，因此没有有关该包的附加信息。 您仍然可以使用 .eval 从实际派生中获取元数据。

该方案依赖于仍然提供十三年历史的路径的cache.nixos.org，值得庆幸的是它确实做到了并且使用相同的签名密钥。

为了证明缓存提供了 Nixpkgs 构建的几乎所有路径，我对每个包的每个索引版本进行了普查，并询问缓存是否仍然存在。

截至 2026 年 8 月 14 日，这 271,187 人全部存活。 所有这些，具体到每个 NAR 有效负载文件。 这是从 2013 年开始的 14.8 TB 解压软件，只需一个快速命令即可完成。11NixOS 基础设施从未对二进制缓存进行垃圾收集。 它是一个只会增长的 S3 存储桶，费用由 NixOS 基金会及其赞助商支付。

nixmultiverse.com 上还有一些有关人口普查、依赖图和其他功能的其他数据。 一探究竟！

所有这些都可以通过 mvs 命令行工具以及离线使用来获得。

# how big is it, unpacked, downloaded, and in full closure
$ mvs size python3@3.8.9
python3 3.8.9 · /nix/store/6cfajs6lsy9b4wxp3jvyyl1g5x2pjmpr-python3-3.8.9
  nar (unpacked)  50.1 MiB
  download        10.6 MiB
  closure         93.8 MiB · 16 paths
  cache           live

# who links against it
$ mvs rdeps pcre2
pcre2 10.47 · referenced by 255 indexed packages

# what is this path in my store, actually
$ mvs identify /nix/store/8qi947kixhz1nw83dkwxm6d0wndprqkj-hello-2.12.2
  package  hello 2.12.2

# run takes the fast path by default
$ mvs run hello@2.12.2
Hello, world!

我想现在有一个警告：多元宇宙现在有一个诡计。 它主要保留了一个索引、一些 JSON 和一个备忘录表后面的 fetchTree。 巧妙的技巧是汤伯雷克的，它是三行重要的台词。
